name: Caer Wydyr
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Caer Wydyr is a Welsh mythological site. The name means the glass fortress. It is another name for Annwn. Annwn is the mythic and magical Otherworld of the Welsh.

okr.objective: Caer Wydyr is the glass fortress of Welsh myth.
